name: Seated Anterior Delt Press (AD)
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold the handles or dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press the weight up and slightly forward.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A seated shoulder press variant that emphasises the front delts.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
safetyNotes: Use a moderate weight; stop with shoulder pain.
